items.Sentence: The headworks includes a rotary hydroscreen system...
The first cell contains two 7.5-horsepower aerators... the third cell contains a 3-horsepower aerator, set on a timer, to create aerobic and anoxic conditions within the pond.
The settling pond (also known as the North Pond) is used for storage during high flows and for filter backwashes. Wastewater from the settling pond is recirculated to the aeration pond as necessary.
Tertiary treatment is achieved in the microfiltration system.
To maintain cleanliness in the filters, the secondary effluent is pre-chlorinated using sodium hypochlorite prior to filtration.
Sodium hypochlorite is stored in a 540-gallon tank and is conveyed to the injection point through a 1-inch line by a pair of peristaltic pumps.

Chlorinated effluent then flows into one of two baffled concrete chambers... After flowing through the chlorine contact tank... the chlorinated effluent is dechlorinated using sodium bisulfite.
Treated wastewater is discharged to an approximately 3.25 million gallon effluent storage pond used for storage of advanced treated wastewater prior to discharge...
Biosolids generated during the treatment process accumulate in the aeration and settling ponds, where they undergo anaerobic digestion and densification.
During the 2012 biosolids removal event, approximately 99 dry tons of solids were removed from the ponds and land-applied by Synagro Technologies, Inc.
The Permittee is planning to optimize use of the high flow storage pond by instituting seasonal changes in the flow regimes and use of aeration and settling functions.
The Permittee is planning... to institute flow pacing for the chlorination and dechlorination system to address elevated sodium and total dissolved solid (TDS) levels.
